contexts.text: From vessels of bowls even to all the vessels of psalteries ().

And put it in basins () = with man, in the things of his memory. Basins = the things of the memory... Basins, here = such things of memory as contain Divine Truths within them, and which Divine Truths are signified, in general, by blood. Explained.
Scientifics are vessels, and in the Word, are signified by all kinds of vessels, as basins, cups, waterpots...
Scientific truths from a celestial stock are vessels of bowls (), and scientific truths from a spiritual stock are vessels of psalteries.
The bells of the horses () = scientific truths from an enlightened Intellectual; and bowls before the altar = scientific goods.
Similar things are signified by the basins of the altar (; 38, 3).
